title: Various: use ws_log system instead of fprintf
description:
Change some dissectors which use (usually `#ifdef`'d out) calls to
`fprintf(stderr,...)` as logging, to use the ws_log system instead.

Use `ws_debug()` for debugging messages.
Use `ws_warning()` for error conditions that appear non-fatal from
context.
Remove trailing `\n` from log messages since the log system handles
those.

Tweak some log messages which were invalid syntax (too few or too many
arguments) that were masked by being `#ifdef`'d out.

In the WTP dissector, also replace `proto_tree_add_debug_text()`.

This is not a complete survey of dissectors using `fprintf()`.

Ping #19519
